The failing test `testEscapedQuote_LANG_477` is trying to create an `ExtendedMessageFormat` instance with a custom format registry and a pattern containing single quotes. The bug report states that when using `ExtendedMessageFormat` with a custom format registry and a pattern containing single quotes, an `OutOfMemoryError` occurs.

Looking at the code of `ExtendedMessageFormat`, it has two constructors:
1. Constructor `public ExtendedMessageFormat(String pattern, Map registry)` calls another constructor with a default locale.
2. Constructor `public ExtendedMessageFormat(String pattern, Locale locale, Map registry)` initializes the `ExtendedMessageFormat` with the specified locale and custom registry.

The issue is most likely related to how the constructor handles the custom format registry when the pattern contains single quotes. The error message suggests that an `OutOfMemoryError` is thrown in this scenario, indicating a possible memory leak or inefficient memory usage when processing patterns with single quotes in the presence of a custom format registry.

To fix this issue, the handling of the custom format registry in the constructor of `ExtendedMessageFormat` needs to be reviewed to ensure efficient memory usage and prevent potential `OutOfMemoryError` when dealing with patterns containing single quotes.

Next, I will suggest methods that can be improved to fix this issue.
Suggested methods to fix the issue:
1. `org.apache.commons.lang.text.ExtendedMessageFormat.ExtendedMessageFormat(java.lang.String, java.util.Map)`
